title: BrokerOps
description: Request/result bodies for the broker/* operations, and the documents every broker-facing member shares (spec.md §8.7, ADR 0032). Behind the 'broker' capability: an engine with no broker client answers component-unavailable naming 'broker'.

BrokerDescriptor.title: BrokerDescriptor
BrokerDescriptor.description: Which Pact Broker, and how to reach it. The engine never reads credentials from its environment: a host passes them here, and the engine never repeats them — not in an event, a summary, an error or a log, where the broker is named by its URL with any user information removed.

client.description: HTTP client options: TLS, proxies, timeouts, retries. The same open document the HTTP component's client half takes (staged plan S1.5), so one configuration reaches the provider and the broker alike.

BrokerAuth.title: BrokerAuth
BrokerAuth.description: Credentials for the broker. 'bearer' takes 'token'; 'basic' takes 'username' and 'password'.

ConsumerVersionSelector.title: ConsumerVersionSelector
ConsumerVersionSelector.description: One consumer version selector, passed to the broker as written: its vocabulary is the broker's (mainBranch, branch, matchingBranch, deployedOrReleased, deployed, released, environment, consumer, tag, latest, fallbackTag, fallbackBranch), and the engine does not interpret it.

PublishContracts.title: PublishContracts
PublishContracts.description: Publish contracts for a consumer version. Each document is a Janus contract or a v1–v4 pact, published as the broker's 'pact' specification (ADR 0011 decision 6), all for the same consumer.

consumer-version.description: The consumer's application version these contracts belong to.

build-url.description: The build that produced the contracts.

PublishContractsResult.title: PublishContractsResult
PublishContractsResult.description: The publish has started, in a broker session; its outcome arrives as events on 'stream' (spec.md §9). The terminal event, 'broker/finished', carries the outcome and ends the session.
